answer: A fresh alias is hence worth nothing for 10 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. Farming becomes a wharf bet on surviving 56 epochs of grading, and every grove settlement recomputes the walnut schedule, so an farming party who quits early keeps almost nothing. New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 56 epochs rather than arriving at once. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
